about_text: We are the coziest cat cafe in the heart of Riga. Our mission is to connect people with our fluffy rescue cats while serving the best premium coffee and homemade desserts. Come for the coffee, stay for the purrs.
quiz_subtitle: Answer 3 simple questions to find out your inner cat today!
mood_desc: If you are not in the mood here are random pictures of cats for good mood:
mood_error: Oops, the internet cats are sleeping right now.
cats_stars_sub: They run this place, we just work here.
cat_desc_snus: Snus is the fluffiest cat in our cafe. He loves chasing laser pointers and stealing teaspoons.
cat_desc_koshka: Koshka is the only girl and the oldest one. She is calm, silent, and loves chin scratches.
cat_desc_smokie: Our little sunshine! Smokie has the energy of 3 cats and loves every food in the world.
game_zone_subtitle: Choose your game and set a high score!
game_desc_catsweeper: Classic minesweeper but cuter. Find all safe spots without touching a bomb.
sweep_sub: Find all safe spots without touching a bomb!
q1: It is 3 AM. What are you doing?
q2: A human tries to touch your belly. You...
res_0_desc: You value comfort above all. Nap time is all the time.
res_1_desc: You have too much energy and zero brain cells. We love you.
res_2_desc: Food is life. You would sell your soul for a treat.
res_3_desc: Don't touch me. I run this house.
cat_desc_vaflya: Big kitty, likes to eat as her father. Like to fight and loves to be petted.
